Kit summary

Brim WhirlBasic
Attacks a single enemy, dealing DMG by 12% of Hania's Max HP, with a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Cold II] for 2 turns. Afterward, the ally with the highest ATK pursues and attacks the same target 1 time.
Gang's InspirationActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Grants all allies [HP Up II] and restores their HP by 18% of Hania's Max HP. Meanwhile, grants them [Ironblood Shield] by 45% of Hania's Max HP for 2 turns, up to 1 layer.
Felt Fedora Lv.1Increases all allies' Tenacity and Mastery RES by 50% when Hania casts Gang's Inspiration. Besides, for every 1 ally with [HP Deduction] exists, additionally increases all allies' Tenacity and Mastery RES by 20% for 2 turns.
Felt Fedora Lv.3Hania additionally casts Gang's Inspiration once while entering [Resonance Enhancement] status. When enemies' (excluding Boss) recorded DMG is higher than self current HP, deducts their HP by the same amount of the recorded value immediately.
Phantom of the WildernessPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Max Limit of Resonance Points: 20. When allies deal HP Deduction DMG to enemies, Hania gains 1 Resonance Point; if the target is a boss, Hania gains 3 Resonance Points instead. During anyone's turns, each enemy (excluding boss) can only grant Hania 1 Resonance Point in this way. If the Resonance Points reach the max limit at the beginning of self turn, Hania will consume all of them to enter [Resonance Enhancement] status for 2 turns, replace Godmother's Fist with Godmother's Fist · Resonance and reset its CD. In the duration of [Resonance Enhancement], Hania cannot get Resonance Points anymore and she gains [Gang's Protection]: When any ally takes Fatal DMG, Hania consumes [Gang's Protection] to immunize the target against death and restores 20% of Hania's Max HP for them, CD: 2 turns. After this effect is triggered, Hania casts Godmother's Fist · Resonance once immediately and exits [Resonance Enhancement] status afterward.
Felt Fedora Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, Hania enters [Resonance Enhancement] status. Hania is able to gain Resonance Points during [Resonance Enhancement].
Godmother's FistActive
Deals 2 stages of DMG by 12% of Hania's Max HP each to all enemies. The first stage additionally makes the target lose 12% of Max HP, caps at 36% of Hania's Max HP. The second stage has a 30% chance to inflict [Stun] for 2 turns. Will be replaced by Godmother's Fist · Resonance during [Resonance Enhancement] status.
